title: Actual local Wilson transition comparison, a rigorous obstruction to local-ratio gap arguments, and a correctly normalized block criterion
status: Partial progress. No volume-independent or physically scaled Yang-Mills mass gap is proved.

lean_certified: Explicit finite product-kernel counterexample, real eigenvalue classification, complex positive semidefiniteness, uniform one-coordinate comparisons, and absence of a uniform excited/top ratio gap.
Actual Wilson one-link ground-state transition row comparison, with the positive continuous eigenfunction equation as an explicit input.
natural_mathematics_not_lean_certified: Reversible heat-bath two-edge coupling comparison and its optimized constant.
Weighted block-factorization/Dirichlet comparison criterion, time normalization, and the parity obstruction to a sum-of-local-variances shortcut.
not_established: Volume-uniform approximate tensorization or strong mixing for the actual Wilson ground-state law.
Volume-independent parallel-block comparison for the actual transfer kernel.
Positive physical continuum mass gap or nonzero interacting continuum theory.

artifacts.scope: A real finite matrix is defined explicitly by its entries and action. The module classifies all REAL pointwise eigenvalues and proves their upper bound, rather than stating a theorem using mathlib spectrum. Symmetry and complex quadratic positive semidefiniteness are proved. The standard finite-dimensional identification of real symmetric-matrix eigenvalues with its spectrum is not separately packaged here.

One actual-kernel theorem. It uses the supplied positive continuous ground eigenfunction and the original spatial Haar eigenfunction equation; it does not assume a gap or a transition comparison. Another swarm module specializes to the constructed Wilson ground state and telescopes finite link sets.

actual_repository_inputs.formula: exp(-24 beta V) <= K_beta(u,v) <= 1, beta>=0, V=card(SpatialVertex n).
actual_repository_inputs.scope: Actual full SU(2) slab, including spatial and temporal plaquettes. This global comparison loses exponentially in spatial volume.

actual_repository_inputs.formula: K(u,v) <= exp(6 |beta| C_chi) K(u_prime,v); psi(u) <= exp(6 |beta| C_chi) psi(u_prime), when u and u_prime differ at one spatial link and |chi|<=C_chi.
actual_repository_inputs.scope: Actual Wilson kernel; eigenfunction comparison follows from the kernel eigenfunction equation, with no partition-volume factor.

actual_repository_inputs.formula: For the normalized one-link row law, E_row[Q] >= exp(-6 |beta| C_chi) E_Haar[Q] for Q>=0.
actual_repository_inputs.scope: Single-link comparison only; it does not supply cross-link mixing or an approximate-tensorization constant.

actual_repository_inputs.formula: P(x,dy)=K(x,y) psi(y)/(lambda0 psi(x)) mu(dy); pi(dx)=psi(x)^2 mu(dx); E_P(f)=1/2 integral (f(x)-f(y))^2 pi(dx)P(x,dy).
actual_repository_inputs.scope: Exact ground-state transform identities. They do not estimate a uniform gap.

certified_counterexample.space: X_N={false,true}^{Fin N}, N>=1, with counting measure for the displayed finite operator.
certified_counterexample.positivity: Every entry K_N(x,y)>0; K_N is symmetric and positive semidefinite, not generally positive definite. Its real quadratic form is (sum f_plus*f)^2+(sum f_minus*f)^2. Arbitrary complex quadratic forms have nonnegative real part and zero imaginary part. For N>=2 the rank-two matrix has zero modes because its ambient dimension is 2^N>2.

eigenvectors.excited: e_N=f_plus-f_minus; T_N e_N=(1-s_N)e_N; sum e_N^2=2(1-s_N)>0; sum g_N e_N=0.

certified_counterexample.eigenvalue_scope: Every real eigenvalue with a nonzero pointwise eigenfunction is 0, 1+s_N, or 1-s_N. The positive ground eigenvalue 1+s_N is consequently the largest real eigenvalue. Both nonzero eigenvalues are explicitly attained for N>=1. There is no hidden compactness/eigenvector assumption.
certified_counterexample.formal_no_uniform_statement: not exists delta>0 such that for every N>=1, r_N<=1-delta.
certified_counterexample.local_bounds: If x and x_prime differ at one coordinate, K_N(x,y)<=4/3 K_N(x_prime,y) and g_N(x)<=4/3 g_N(x_prime). These constants do not depend on N.
certified_counterexample.additional_natural_consequences: The normalized stationary density proportional to g_N^2 has one-coordinate ratios at most 16/9. Its Doob transition has one-coordinate row ratios at most 16/9, while its nonconstant eigenvalue ratio remains r_N.
certified_counterexample.measure_convention: With normalized counting/Haar measure 2^(-N) sum, retaining the same kernel scales both eigenvalues by 2^(-N), leaving r_N unchanged. Alternatively multiply K_N by 2^N to retain the displayed eigenvalues; local ratios and positive semidefiniteness are unchanged.
certified_counterexample.what_it_rules_out: No theorem using only strict pointwise positivity, symmetry, positive semidefiniteness, and volume-uniform one-coordinate kernel/ground/transition ratios can conclude a volume-uniform spectral gap.
certified_counterexample.what_it_does_not_rule_out: This is not Wilson theory: the shared latent product component creates nonlocal collective correlations. It does not refute a theorem exploiting genuine Wilson plaquette locality plus a proved inter-block mixing estimate, and it does not refute the Yang-Mills conjecture.

actual_transition_comparison.general_formula: P(u,dy) <= exp(12 |beta| C_chi) P(u_prime,dy) for configurations differing at one spatial link.
actual_transition_comparison.proof: The kernel ratio contributes exp(6 |beta| C_chi). The reverse ground-function ratio contributes the same factor because psi(u_prime)<=exp(6 |beta| C_chi) psi(u). Multiply these inequalities and use positivity of lambda0 and psi in the exact Doob formula. No spatial-volume estimate appears.
actual_transition_comparison.su2_convention: The repository uses unnormalized fundamental trace, C_chi=2 and action beta sum_p(2-Re Tr U_p). For beta>=0 the transition ratio is exp(24 beta).
actual_transition_comparison.finite_block_natural_extension: Changing b links one at a time yields R_B=exp(12 |beta| C_chi b), hence R_B=exp(24 beta b) for SU(2). Another swarm module owns the actual-ground finite-set formalization.

proved_natural_local_dirichlet_compariso.status: Full natural-mathematics proof below; not Lean-certified in these two files.
proved_natural_local_dirichlet_compariso.setup: Let pi=psi^2 mu be the actual normalized ground law and P its reversible transition. Let Q_B be the exact pi-heat-bath kernel that resamples links in B conditional on the complement. Let b=card B. The complement is fixed by Q_B; Q_B is pi-reversible. For the actual compact SU(2) product space this conditional law has an explicit normalized positive density.
proved_natural_local_dirichlet_compariso.input_already_reduced_to_actual_local_bo: For x and x_prime agreeing outside B, P(x,dy)<=R_B P(x_prime,dy), R_B=exp(24 beta b).
proved_natural_local_dirichlet_compariso.coupling: Sample X~pi; then conditionally on X, sample X_prime~Q_B(X,.) and Y~P(X,.) independently. Denote the resulting three-variable probability by Gamma.
proved_natural_local_dirichlet_compariso.edge1: The (X,Y) marginal of Gamma is J_P(dx,dy)=pi(dx)P(x,dy).
proved_natural_local_dirichlet_compariso.edge2_proof: Reversibility of Q_B rewrites the (X_prime,Y) marginal as pi(dx_prime) integral Q_B(x_prime,dx) P(x,dy). Every x in that conditional support agrees with x_prime outside B; the row comparison therefore bounds this marginal by R_B pi(dx_prime)P(x_prime,dy).
proved_natural_local_dirichlet_compariso.conclusion: E_Q_B(f) <= A_B E_P(f), A_B=(1+sqrt(R_B))^2. Thus for SU(2), A_B=(1+exp(12 beta b))^2. This is independent of total spatial volume but depends exponentially on coupling and block cardinality.
proved_natural_local_dirichlet_compariso.direct_density_caveat: The heat-bath edge law is supported on equal outside-B coordinates and is singular relative to a full continuous transition edge law when B is proper. Direct domination of Q_B edge densities by J_P is generally impossible. The two-edge coupling avoids this mistake.

correctly_normalized_block_criterion.status: A sufficient analytic reduction with explicit auxiliary mixing quantities. The corresponding uniform estimates for Wilson theory remain unproved.
correctly_normalized_block_criterion.block_form: Choose blocks B and weights alpha_B>=0 with sum_B alpha_B=1. Let Q=sum_B alpha_B Q_B and gamma(alpha)=min_link sum_{B containing link} alpha_B. Then E_Q(f)=sum_B alpha_B E_pi[Var(f | outside B)].
correctly_normalized_block_criterion.auxiliary_mixing_target: Prove gamma(alpha) Var_pi(f) <= C sum_B alpha_B E_pi[Var(f | outside B)] for all centered square-integrable f. C must be quantified for the actual ground-state law, not a supplied product law.
correctly_normalized_block_criterion.comparison_consequence: The proved local coupling gives E_Q(f)<=A E_P(f), with A=sum_B alpha_B A_B (or max_B A_B). Therefore E_P(f)>=gamma(alpha)/(C A) Var_pi(f), and every nonconstant positive eigenvalue ratio satisfies r<=1-gamma(alpha)/(C A).
correctly_normalized_block_criterion.physical_time: For one lattice time step a, the resulting energy floor is -log(1-gamma/(C A))/a, at least gamma/(a C A). A positive limit requires a quantitatively suitable behavior of gamma/(C A), rather than only positivity at fixed cutoff.
correctly_normalized_block_criterion.single_block_time_normalization: For M disjoint equally weighted blocks of bounded size, alpha=1/M and gamma=1/M. A continuous-time heat-bath generator that updates every block at unit rate has M times the clock rate of this random-scan Markov step. Dropping this factor incorrectly manufactures a volume-free transfer bound.
correctly_normalized_block_criterion.parallel_color_option: A cover by q color unions, each chosen with weight 1/q, has gamma>=1/q. But each union contains order volume links. Applying the proved row comparison to the entire union makes A exponential in volume. Replacing the union update by independent bounded-block updates requires actual conditional independence or a quantitative comparison controlling their interactions; neither follows from a local ground-function ratio.
correctly_normalized_block_criterion.fixed_time_block_option: Apply a genuinely volume-uniform auxiliary comparison to P^k with k approximately ell/a and constants independent of a and spatial volume. A fixed contraction over physical time ell would yield a physical spectral floor. The parent module formalizes this spectral conversion; the missing content is the actual inter-block estimate, not the conversion.
correctly_normalized_block_criterion.sum_local_variances_no_go: Even for an independent product law and a positive-semidefinite Markov contraction P, E_P(f)<=Var(f). Here positive semidefinite means nonnegative quadratic form (equivalently, nonnegative spectrum for self-adjoint P), not merely positivity-preserving or a pointwise positive transition kernel. For the parity function on N fair bits, Var(f)=1 and sum_i E Var(f | outside i)=N. Thus an unrestricted form inequality E_P>=c sum_i E Var_i cannot have c independent of N. Use correctly normalized random-scan or bounded-color updates.

rate_audit_of_current_constants.fixed_physical_box: For lattice spacing a and a fixed physical three-dimensional spatial box, V is of order a^(-3).
rate_audit_of_current_constants.coupling_branch: Suppose beta(a)=b0 log(1/a)+O(log log(1/a)), b0>0. This is a stipulated branch here, not a proved physical trajectory.
rate_audit_of_current_constants.fixed_size_blocks: For block cardinality b and SU(2), A_B grows like a^(-24 b0 b) times logarithmic factors. Equally weighted bounded-size blocks have gamma of order 1/V. Even if C were uniform, the certified lower-bound expression gamma/(a C A_B) is only of order a^(2+24 b0 b) up to logarithms and tends to zero.
rate_audit_of_current_constants.interpretation: This is failure of the available estimate to prove a positive physical floor; it is not evidence that the actual mass gap vanishes.
rate_audit_of_current_constants.what_must_improve: Use correlation information to obtain parallel-block/time-block comparison without an extensive oscillation cost, and prove the actual ground-law variance factorization with the required cutoff behavior.

concrete_mixing_quantity_for_next_attack.finite_volume_object: For an actual finite link region Lambda and exterior condition tau, define the normalized conditional Wilson law mu_Lambda^tau from the original plaquette action. For an interior link set Delta and a single changed exterior link e, compare the exact marginal densities on Delta.
concrete_mixing_quantity_for_next_attack.quantity: I(Lambda,Delta,e)=sup_{tau,tau_prime differing only at e} || d mu_{Lambda,Delta}^{tau_prime}/d mu_{Lambda,Delta}^{tau} - 1 ||_infinity.
concrete_mixing_quantity_for_next_attack.target: A quantitatively verified decay of I with separation, on suitable overlapping physical-size blocks, is a concrete route to a block factorization estimate. The present local oscillation theorem only bounds nearby conditional densities; it supplies no decay in the distance from e to Delta.
concrete_mixing_quantity_for_next_attack.finite_size_caution: A single arbitrarily chosen box estimate is not automatically a Dobrushin-Shlosman criterion. One must specify and prove the relevant finite-size influence norm, overlap geometry, and its recursion for the plaquette link interaction, including boundary/gauge treatment.
concrete_mixing_quantity_for_next_attack.ground_law_caution: The spatial marginal psi^2 may have effective interactions of unbounded range after temporal integration. Locality of the original four-dimensional action must not be silently transferred to this marginal.

primary_sources.title: Comparison Theorems for Reversible Markov Chains
primary_sources.locator: Annals of Applied Probability 3(3), 696-730; Section 2, equation (2.1) and comparison framework.
primary_sources.use: Primary background for comparing reversible Dirichlet forms and spectral gaps. The specific continuous Wilson two-edge coupling proof above is provided explicitly and is not asserted to be a theorem copied from this finite-state paper.

primary_sources.title: Block Factorization of the Relative Entropy via Spatial Mixing
primary_sources.locator: Preprint pp.2-3, equations (1.3)-(1.5); pp.4-5 setup/extensions; p.6 Definition 2.1 and equation (2.2).
primary_sources.use: Gives the coverage factor gamma(alpha) and derives block functional inequalities from strong spatial mixing. The single-spin space can be an arbitrary probability space, including compact spins. The stated interaction is nearest-neighbor pairwise; the authors explicitly say extension to general finite-range interactions is not immediate. Wilson four-link plaquettes and the effective ground marginal therefore require a justified adaptation or a direct proof. The paper does not prove the missing weak-coupling Wilson mixing estimate.

primary_sources.authors: R. L. Dobrushin and S. B. Shlosman
primary_sources.title: Completely Analytical Interactions: Constructive Description
primary_sources.use: Primary precedent for reducing complete-analyticity/mixing conditions to specified finite-volume checks. It is not treated as an already instantiated theorem for the present compact-group plaquette model or its physical weak-coupling branch.

Construct the exact block heat-bath kernel for psi^2 and formalize the two-edge coupling comparison, preserving its block-cardinality and clock factors.
Attack actual spatial conditional correlations or a finite-size influence norm. A bound only on one-link density oscillation cannot suffice, as the certified rank-two family shows.

If an auxiliary block variance factorization is established, test its C(a,L) together with the genuine transfer comparison A(a,L) and the update coverage gamma; report the resulting physical rate without deleting volume/time factors.
